Key judgments:
- **Delmar** and **Meridian** were the two that would have been wrong as straight expense. Policy 4 requires prepaid treatment for >$1,000 items spanning future periods, including *deposits for future events*, so the booth deposit sits on the balance sheet until the June expo.
- All five went to **2000 AP** (not accrued expenses) — they're invoiced, Net 30, and I confirmed no March cash moved against any of them in the US bank data.
- Each entry is under the USD 10,000 posting threshold, so no controller approval was needed; I kept Delmar as one entry rather than splitting it, per the anti-splitting rule.

Net effect: AP +27,395.55, March P&L +14,395.55, prepaids +13,000.00. Two amortization streams carry forward (Delmar 800/mo through Feb 2027; Meridian 4,200 release in June).

I left **US "AP cutoff review" as in_progress** rather than complete — these five bills are done, but a full cutoff review for goods/services received in March and not yet invoiced (policy 5 accruals) is still outstanding. No exceptions were flagged; all five were fully supported.
